about: Team Trials meta for umaLord's Team Trials planner (app/src/parentage/tt.rs). Hand-curated from community guides; how to refresh it is in knowledge/UPDATING.md. Community opinion, not game data, except where a field says rule.

sources.name: umareference, PvP Team Trials (Global edition, Erzzy)

rules.note: Game rules as the guides state them: five races (Dirt always a mile-ish distance), one slot per race at first, a second at Class 2, a third at Class 3; every uma once in the team, alternate outfits of one uma included; the top slot of each race is its Ace (+10% of her score); placement 10,000 / 8,000 / 7,000 / 6,000 / 5,000 / 4,000 ×2 / 3,000 ×2 / 2,000 ×3; team bonus 5,000 (all three top 3) or 4,000 (all top 5); winning 3 of 5 races adds 10,000; skills gold 1,200, white or green 500, inherited unique 500, own unique 2,000 to 2,600 at 3★ or more by its level (1,500 to 2,000 below 3★); Strong Start 1,000; good positioning 1,000 each in early, mid and late race per running style on the race's team.
rules.source: uma.guide Team Trials (2026-10-05); Game8 (2026-08-14); umareference Format (2026-08-26)

tracks.note: How often each length comes up in each race (umareference, Global, 2026-08-26). The planner races the most common length.

stamina.note: Most Stamina a runner should need (uma.guide, 2026-10-05): Medium 700-800 or 600-700 plus a gold recovery; Long 800-900 plus a gold recovery, or 700 plus two.

scenario.name: Grand Concert
scenario.why: the best scenario for Team Trials runners until most of the support grid is UF or above (uma.guide, 2026-10-05)

inherit.why: Summer Gold Ship's unique: worth inheriting on every member; a white skill (500) that fires a random gold (1,200 more) in the second half (uma.guide, 2026-10-05)

borrows.note: Friend support cards to borrow, best first (uma.guide, 2026-10-05). Light Hello first in Grand Concert (her R card uncapped works too; the planner names the SSR); then by race and by style. Mihono Bourbon's free Halloween card (30066) gives Concentration in Grand Concert.

skills.why: Generic skills that fire for most runners on most tracks score; skills tied to track features or strict conditions don't (uma.guide, 2026-10-05). Concentration raises the chance of the 1,000-point Strong Start.

roles.note: Each outfit's usual Team Trials races and running styles, best first (umareference Uma Distances / Styles, 2026-08-26; uma.guide's trainee notes, 2026-10-05). unique: inconsistent marks a unique whose conditions make it fire unreliably, which costs points.
